title: Household appliance energy forecasts

drift.method: last value plus full-history average change

seasonal_naive.method: repeat the last complete seasonal cycle

boosted.target: future value minus value at issue time

config.origin_schedule: 5-day or 25-hour spacing visits all weekdays or hours instead of fixing one clock slot
config.forecast_issue_time: after the origin period has ended and its measurements are available
config.selection_metric: validation MAE separately per horizon; ties broken by model name
config.evaluation_policy: expanding-window rolling refits, including already observed earlier test values
config.interval_boundary_tolerance: 1e-9 * max(1, abs(actual)) for numeric serialization at inclusive bounds
config.interval_method: absolute calibration residual at rank ceil((n+1)*0.8), frozen per model and horizon
config.negative_forecasts: clipped to zero for every model; interval lower bounds also clipped

limitations: Historical experiments, not live forecasts or trading recommendations.
Fixed configurations compare model families, not exhaustive hyperparameter searches.
Selection uses validation only. Test values are not used to choose models or interval widths.
Later test forecasts may learn from earlier test observations once those observations are available.
Calibration errors are serially dependent; nominal 80% intervals have no guaranteed coverage.
Origins are sparse, so metrics do not describe forecasts issued at every possible timestamp.
Development runs preceded a calendar-sampling correction; these historical results are not fresh external validation.
MAPE excludes zero actuals; MASE excludes zero seasonal training scales, with counts reported.
